_comment: Settlement tiers (DESIGN §3.3, DECIDED 2026-11-04). ORDER IS INDEX-STABLE: never reorder or remove, only append. Zones are in rings around the centre (ring 1 = centre + 6 neighbours = 7 hexes; 2 → 19; 3 → 37; 4 → 61; 5 → 91; 6 → 127). City 5 rings and metropolis 6 rings from 12,000 decided by Omer 2026-11-04 after the A/B test.. Population ranges are draft. 'hall' and 'granary' are the two buildings every settlement has from founding (data/buildings.json).
